heuristics.statement: The first blocks M0 are fresh uniform 512-bit strings and their chaining values cv = F_38(IV, M0) behave as independent uniform 256-bit values. Consequences used, all as expectations over the random chaining value (for a fixed chaining value and R the table is determined): the 2^27 table values F(a0) are distributed as independent uniform words for the table statistics (bucket loads Binomial(2^27, 2^-23), E[min(load, 7)] = 6.994098 stored lanes, uniform tags, 160 x 6.994098 / 512 = 2.185656 expected claws per scan word); F7 has probability |F7|/2^32; the good pairs and the online works W_j of different chaining values are independent (proof.md Lemma 4, Section 7).
heuristics.scope: Expected claw and budget means, the bucket/tag law, independent complete-CV budgets in Bernstein, and the product over fresh chaining values. Current proof Sections4,6 and7.
heuristics.extrapolation: Historical staged-candidate evidence, historical statistical evidence, not a new v4 probability report. Our C port of the bucket claw at full table size (2^23 buckets, 2^27 candidates) on 64 seed-drawn chaining values, 2^22 scan words each: claws 586,702,214, claws/expected 0.99999, stored lanes per bucket 6.994111 (expected 6.994098); with the full table the claws equal an independent reference search (chaining value 24: 573,516 claws, reference 573,516; chaining value 25: 572,352 claws, reference 572,352); the C port reproduces p1b38.run_cv (which executes the SWAR test literally) exactly at reduced sizes. The organizer experiment p1b-online-r38 reports stored lanes, claws and reference claws on seed-drawn chaining values.
heuristics.limitations: A premise, not a theorem: over the random chaining value the table values and the claws are taken to follow the random-function law in expectation; checked at full table size on 64 chaining values, not on 2^53 of them. The sealed v4 implementation adds no statistical evidence for this premise; Section5 applies the same inherited probability parameters and charged allowances.

heuristics.statement: For the claws the procedure finds, Pr[C1 and C2 and G and F7] >= q_pf = 116,189,231,624,828 x 287,309,824 / 2^91 = 2^-16.17850: P(C1) = 1/8, |C1 and C2| = 53,096,854 over a1, the C1 C2 G count of the smallest of P's four 2^25-windows times four (116,189,231,624,828 over 2^59), |F7| = 287,309,824; the stage rates set the mean post-filter cost. For mean-cost upper bounds, H1-P1 also transfers P(C1)<=1/8, P(C1C2)<=53096854/2^32, P(C1C2G)<=116189231640576/2^59, and the corresponding qpf upper using287309824/2^32 to retained claws. Success uses the minimum-window lower bound separately.
heuristics.scope: Good-pair success lower bounds and marginal reached-stage cost upper bounds on retained claws. Current proof Sections4 and6.
heuristics.extrapolation: Historical staged-candidate evidence, historical statistical evidence, not a new v4 probability report. Exact counts by our exhaustive programs (gwin38, recomputed identically in small memory by gwin38lm; proof.md Appendix R.1). Full-size bucket panel (64 chaining values, 7,699 good pairs): C1 0.12498, C2|C1 2^-3.3388 (exact 2^-3.3379), G|C1C2 2^-5.9358 (exact over P 2^-5.9387), F7|C1C2G 0.06503 (0.06689), good per claw 2^-16.2176; dispersion chi-square on 63 dof: C1 77.2 and C2 49.4 binomial, G 437.5 (by design: each chaining value's kept a0 follow its own rotation R; averaged over R the law is uniform on P and the pooled G rate matches), F7 158.4 (it reads the chaining value). The stored a0 are the first 7 candidates per bucket in the order o = rotr2((n + R) mod 2^27) with R a fresh random word per chaining value, so their law averaged over R is uniform on P (with R = 0 the panel showed a lower G rate, 2^-5.9937, proof.md Appendix H.5); the charge uses the smallest window count, a lower bound for any mixture of the windows.
heuristics.limitations: A premise that the exhaustive rates hold for the claws found; F7 varies with the chaining value (E[K^2]/E[K]^2 = 1.0248. in the panel). The sealed v4 implementation adds no statistical evidence for this premise; Section5 applies the same inherited probability parameters and charged allowances.

heuristics.statement: A good pair is accepted by step 3b with probability q3r >= q3_P1 x 2^32 / 160 = 2^-71.3657, where q3_P1 = 2^-96.0438 = q3_model x 2^min(0, D_LB(A0), D_LB(A0sel)): q3_model = 2^-96.0133 is the registered accepted-event rate (E18 = E17 not imposed) of the A0-variant good pairs on P8 before row 16 (e4243e7a, from 9aaf71a2's registered runs), and the D_LB are our registered one-sided 99% lower bounds of the paired per-seed difference log2 q(P1 on P) - log2 q(reference) for the A0 family (-0.02721) and for the 196,608 selected variants on which q3_model was measured (-0.03042).
heuristics.extrapolation: Historical staged-candidate evidence, historical statistical evidence, not a new v4 probability report. Registered runs, registration texts, hashes, per-seed values and every result line in proof.md Appendix P (40 seeds, three families, our q3tv, rows 16..22 by splitting, final stage rows 23..37 with the outputs compared); the base runs' registrations and per-seed values reproduced in Appendix Q.
heuristics.limitations: The nominal joint confidence of at least 97% applies to the three registered statistics (level, relaxation ratio, and mean per-seed paired log-difference), not to the online arithmetic acceptance-rate ratio used by H2-P1. A mean log-ratio does not by itself bound that arithmetic ratio; equal seed weighting omits prefix/claw weights, and the descriptive pooled counts omit them too. The 17 of 40 seeds stalled at row20 in the shared prefix and are symmetrically excluded by the registered rule, but a rigorous transfer would require a prefix-weighted linear-ratio analysis with stalled prefixes included. The A0sel amendment was written after 7 seeds of the first two families were seen and charges the smaller bound. The estimator conditions on row22 while the base tool starts its final stage there. P1 pairs follow the exact C1 C2 G law on P, not the online claw law. Thus q3_P1>=2^-96.0438 remains an explicit score-critical extrapolation premise supported by these studies, not a consequence of their confidence interval. Sealed v3 adds no statistical evidence.

heuristics.statement: Pairwise behaviour of acceptance over the random chaining value (all probabilities over the procedure's coins: the random first block, hence by H1 a uniform chaining value, and the rotation R; nothing is conditional on the chaining value or its good pairs, which determine the outcome). With p = E[X_j]/E[K_j] the mean acceptance rate of good pairs (H2-P1: p >= q3r): for two claw positions c, c' sharing neither a0 nor u, Pr[c and c' both accepted] <= p^2 Pr[c and c' both good]; for linked positions (sharing a0 or u) nothing beyond Pr[A_c and A_c'] <= Pr[A_c and G_c'] is assumed, and a good pair's acceptance is not positively correlated with its number of linked partners. Consequence used (Lemma 5): E[X_j(X_j - 1)] <= 2 p E[L_j] + p^2 E[K_j(K_j - 1)], hence by the second-moment bound Pr[X_j >= 1] >= E[X_j]^2/E[X_j^2] >= q3r E[K_j] (1 - 2 E[L_j]/E[K_j] - q3r E[K_j^2]/E[K_j]) >= (1 - 2^-6.5) q3r E[K_j].
heuristics.scope: The factor (1 - 2^-6.5) per chaining value (proof.md Sections 7, 8).
heuristics.extrapolation: Historical staged-candidate evidence, historical statistical evidence, not a new v4 probability report. The link rate is measured exactly at the full scan: for all 7,699 good pairs of the bucket panel, every claw of the same a0 over all 2^32 scan words was enumerated and tested: 47 good partners (0.006105 per good pair, 2.8 times the independent rate 2^-8.85); the one-sided 99% bounds and the u links give E[L]/E[K] <= 0.0049, so 2 E[L]/E[K] + 2^-50 < 2^-6.5 (proof.md Section 8, Appendix H.3); the earlier measurement on 7,789 good pairs of the residue table (same set P) gave 0.006548. Second-moment term: q3r E[K^2]/E[K] < 2^-50.
heuristics.limitations: The pairwise behaviour of the rows 17..37 event between unlinked good pairs, over the random chaining value, is the premise and is not testable at any sample size (an accepted pair has probability about 2^-71). The link rate is measured on the good pairs of 64 chaining values. The sealed v4 implementation adds no statistical evidence for this premise; Section5 applies the same inherited probability parameters and charged allowances.
